title: By 15 months, most children try a phone, cup, or book in its usual way
summary: The CDC says that by 15 months, most children try to use things the right way, like a phone, a cup, or a book.
body: Under cognitive milestones at 15 months, the CDC lists trying to use things the right way, with a phone, a cup, or a book as the examples. The item is about using an object for its usual job. It is one line on the US list for most children by 15 months. A child who still bangs a cup is not given a diagnosis by this sentence.

sources.title: Milestones by 15 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page, public domain. Updated and reviewed 16 May 2026. Supports the cognitive item 'Tries to use things the right way, like a phone, cup, or book.'
